REGULAR MEETING
OF THE
CITY COUNCIL AND
REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
THURSDAY - APRIL 28, 2011 - CITY HALL -
7:00 P.M.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, BLOOMFIELD AVENUE AT 183RD STREET
A G E N D A
Public input will be allowed on all Agenda items at the time each matter comes up for discussion. Please complete and submit a blue Speaker's Card to ensure that you are recognized when the Agenda item is considered.

Call to Order
2.
Invocation
3.
Pledge of Allegiance
4.
Roll Call
5.
Presentations
6.
Public Comments
CONSENT CALENDAR
7.
Approval of Registers of Demands
8.
Approval of Minutes
9.

10.
Consideration of appointments to vacancies on various commissions, boards, and committees
11.
PUBLIC HEARINGS
11A.
Resolution of the Cerritos City Council approving the Cerritos Certified Housing Element Annual Progress Report
11B.
Proposal by J & A Enterprises Groups, Inc. to remodel the interior and exterior of the existing service station mechanic bay building located at 11004 South Street, Cerritos, CA to convert the automobile service station use to a convenience service station use
12.
PUBLIC WORKS ACTIVITIES
12A.
Award of contract for professional potable water diving services to clean C-2 Reservoir west at 16540 Marquardt Avenue.
13.
NEW AND OLD BUSINESS
12A.
Resolution of the Cerritos City Council to promote and improve communications and relations between the City and its employees.
Resolution of the Cerritos City Council providing for certain adjustments in the employment system and the personnel policies for full-time non-exempt employees represented by AFSCME Local 619.
Resolution of the Cerritos City Council providing for certain adjustments in the employment system and the personnel policies, for full-time exempt employees, full-time confidential employees, and all part-time temporary employees, including part-time employees represented by AFSCME Local 619.
Resolution of Intention to approve an amendment to contract between the Board of Administration CALPERS retirement system and the Cerritos City Council.
Resolution of the Cerritos City Council paying and reporting to the Public Employees Retirement System the value of employer paid member contributions.
Introduce an Ordinance of the Cerritos City Council authorizing an amendment to the contract between the Cerritos City Council and the Board of Administration of the CALPERS.
14.
REPORT ON PENDING LEGISLATION
15.
CITY COUNCIL COMMUNICATIONS/COMMITTEE REPORTS/REPORT ON MEETINGS
16.
CLOSED SESSION
16A.
Personnel matters pursuant to California Government Code Section 54957.6 for Fiscal Year beginning July 1, 2011: Conference with Labor Negotiators. Agency Negotiators: Denise Manoogian, Patricia Leyva, Art Gallucci, and Charles H. Goldstein. Employee Organization: AFSCME Local 619
